home.metaDescription: Jaeung Kim, a web engineer in Seoul.
paragraphs: I write software for a living. Outside of work I'm usually playing basketball, out with friends, or planning my next trip, with Olivia Dean playing somewhere in the background.
At work I sweat the small stuff, probably more than I need to. Once I find a bug, I can't let it go until it's fixed.
This site ends up being a bit of both. I use it to try out whatever I'm curious about, and to hold on to photos from my trips.

resume.metaDescription: Resume of Jaeung Kim, a web engineer in Seoul: experience, projects, and education.
resume.name: Jaeung (Jae) Kim
intro: Hi, I'm Jaeung Kim, a web developer with five years of experience. I'm currently building an AI ontology platform for automotive R&D, where users ask questions in natural language and trace each answer to its source.
As a frontend developer, I work with designers and backend engineers from planning onward, turning complex requirements into something simple everyone can align on.
I write code that teammates and AI tools can read at a glance, and set up AI workflows the whole team can use.

e8ight.role: Senior Software Engineer | Platform Development Team
platformBullets: Unified the shared UI package, Storybook design system, lint and i18n templates, and branching strategy into one monorepo standard that lets new products skip setup
Migrated the legacy CRA build to Vite and pnpm workspaces and added a Jenkins/Docker pipeline, cutting CI builds 80% (10 minutes to under 2)
Self-hosted Sentry to centralize error logs across products and alert on incidents
Enforced lint, type checks, and commit conventions at commit time, holding engineers and coding agents to the same standard
Built the team's coding agent environment (15 custom commands and workflows, role-specific subagents, skills), now the web team standard and spreading to the backend team

hyundai.title: Hyundai Motor R&D data integration platform
hyundai.description: Internal platform that integrates Hyundai Motor R&D data into an ontology-based knowledge graph. Led the web application architecture and built the graph visualization SDK and LLM chat.
sdkBullets: Architected the graph visualization SDK shared by all GraphRAG products: rendering and d3-force layout in a React-free core behind one imperative handle, so internal rewrites never break call sites

Capped nodes per screen around neighborhood-based exploration, rejecting WebGL bulk renderers such as sigma.js after evaluation. Rendered directly to Canvas 2D with idle pausing and bitmap label caching to keep interaction responsive
Kept fast-changing state outside React and propagated only real data changes, eliminating needless re-renders in large lists
hyundai.llmHeading: LLM chat integrated with the knowledge graph
llmBullets: Rendered each GraphRAG answer's supporting subgraph on an adjacent canvas, so users trace sources directly on the graph
Split the WebSocket stream into text, reasoning steps, and graph evidence, and buffered display through a per-frame token queue to minimize re-renders
Paced token output with catch-up acceleration and instant snap on stop or error, rendering only completed markdown segments so partial code blocks and formulas never break the layout

digitalTwin.title: Digital Twin Federation integrated portal
digitalTwin.description: Government R&D program portal that brings external digital twin tools and partner deliverables into one shell. Delivered on schedule as the sole full-stack engineer, from the auth and organization model through the Next.js 15 web app and NestJS backend.
bullets: Enforced authentication and authorization through global deny-by-default guards, so no endpoint ships unauthenticated
Kept tokens in HttpOnly cookies only, with refresh token rotation and reuse detection to block token theft
Gated security settings by environment variable so one deployment image serves both public HTTPS and internal HTTP

products.title: Company product suite (NAXiS, PMIS, NDX Cloud, and others)
products.description: Led web development for five company products.
naxisBullets: Built a no-code graph editor for ontologies with the domain model (entity types, relations, serialization) decoupled from React Flow, so other products adopted it unchanged
Collapsed hundred-edge hubs into relation group nodes, merged identical relations into one edge, and relaid out only the affected region on expand and collapse
pmisBullets: Rebuilt a tree of thousands of rows with lazy loading and virtual scrolling, cutting initial load 80% (12 seconds to 2)
Parallelized drawing uploads (19 files from 4 minutes to 20 seconds) with optimistic UI and rollback for instant feedback
ndxCloudBullets: Unified four permission tiers (organization, project, site, dataset) into one RBAC matrix, enforced consistently down to the screen
Limited EXIF extraction for 4,000 images to the JPEG APP1 marker, cutting memory from 20 GB to 800 MB
Moved uploads to direct browser-to-S3 with presigned URLs, halving upload time (20 minutes to 10) and cutting server load 70%

bullets: First and sole engineer at a clothing marketplace startup, owning stack selection, application architecture, deployment, and operations
Built a marketplace over multiple Shopify seller stores: products and orders stayed in each store, the platform owned discovery and purchase
Layered Instagram and TikTok Login Kit on Supabase Auth as the single identity provider, so social sign-in shares one session model
Chose Shopify Payments over a custom gateway, keeping card data out of the platform while improving cart abandonment and transaction success
Owned the full stack at an EMR (electronic medical records) SaaS startup: marketing site, internal admin portal, backend API, and AWS infrastructure
Designed and shipped the WebGL (Three.js) 3D marketing site solo, from concept through deployment
Built scroll-driven and page transition interactions with GSAP and Framer Motion
Designed and ran the HR and attendance admin portal for non-technical executives, with screens that needed no training
Built the Express backend API, MongoDB schema, AWS infrastructure, and CI/CD pipeline
Designed the React component architecture for a cryptocurrency exchange, separating shared components from screen code so new screens composed from existing pieces
Designed the credit card integration and built the crypto purchase flow from card authorization to asset credit
Fixed blank social previews for SPA links with Lambda@Edge, injecting per-route Open Graph tags at the CloudFront edge without changing how the app renders
Partnered with designers in Figma to reconcile design intent with implementation, component by component

gantt: Published an open source Gantt chart for React 18 and 19 on npm as a fully controlled component: each committed edit emits the complete next task list through one callback

Isolated calendar, task tree, and timeline geometry as pure modules tested without React. Drag, keyboard, and panel edits share one commit path, so working-day snapping behaves the same from every input
Virtualized rows and time cells across five scales from day to year, with a bundle that depends only on React and stays under 40 kB gzipped
Shipped without a toolbar, with scale driven through an imperative handle and theming through CSS variables
Added full keyboard support for moving, resizing, and reordering tasks, with edits announced to screen readers, plus English and Korean docs and a live playground
